why: Many India items mix attack alarms with routine repair, so defence and upkeep are hard to separate by gate alone.

why.T3-151: The item is built around reciprocity with neighbours and allies, asking or returning help after earlier saving of flags.
why.T3-010: It also asks neighbours to move, coexist, keep limits and respect borders, which is a separate line/space settlement.
why.T3-011: It contains direct help sent to allies and visitors, such as defending r/homestuck or placing for India from elsewhere.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-151 cannot carry the border and coexistence requests that settle where neighbours may stand.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0245372, C1363807, C1004751, C0677530, C0795001 and C0671461 ask neighbours to move, coexist, or keep limits.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-010; dropping it loses the border/space settlement but keeps the reciprocity reading.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-151 cannot carry direct help sent to allies or visitors with nothing asked in return.

multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-011; dropping it loses direct assistance but keeps the reciprocity and border material.

multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-011; dropping it loses the aid to Pakistan but keeps the truce and fighting material.
